design.md's ## ADR Change Log section (lines 136-146) states 'No new ADR' and cites three existing ADRs as the unrevised governing decisions: ADR-0010, ADR-0016, ADR-0023 — all three confirmed present at docs/adr/0010-loop-inventory-and-fixture-vocabulary.md, docs/adr/0016-workflow-axes-separation.md, docs/adr/0023-track-selection-contract-migration.md. The design explicitly reasons why no new ADR is required (this is an additive-extension-only design following INV-006's existing effort-object flag pattern, not a new technology/integration/architectural departure) and explicitly names the one scenario that would require a future ADR-0010 revision ('if Phase 2/3 discovers a genuinely new loop-shaped surface... that is an ADR-0010 revision decision for the Phase 2 task to raise separately, not a decision this package makes') without silently absorbing that decision here.
